text:
sara: @here Harbor-3 (model id: harbor-3) is GA on Hosted API! :tada: Streaming + Tool-calling v3 are GA as well. Full docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/hosted/harbor-3

sara: Quick curl example:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"model":"harbor-3","input":"Summarize the meeting notes","stream":true,"tool_call":true}'
```

sara: Important migration notes: tool_call payloads now include structured 'tool_args' (see migration guide). Old streaming SDK v1 will be deprecated in 90 days — migration guide: https://docs.redwood.ai/migrate/stream-v1-to-v3

kevin: Nice! For Dedicated customers can they pin an older model while we roll? any special steps?

sara: Yes — Dedicated & Private customers can pin model versions via the Console: Settings → Models → Pin. For API pinning use the header `x-redwood-model: harbor-2@<version>` to force a variant.

ana: What's the default streaming concurrency + token limit for Hosted? We need to update the SDK limits page.

ops-eng: Canary deployed to us-west-2 at 1813456799. Watching latency and token churn.

deploy-bot: deploy: hosted-harbor3-stream-v3 rolled to canary (us-west-2) — no errors reported in first 5m.

sara: Default streaming concurrency is 200 streams/org; max tokens per stream = 65k by default (contact support for increases). We'll add those numbers to the limits doc.

support-sre: Added a canned Zendesk reply "Harbor-3 GA: migration & common issues" and a KB article.

kevin: Any breaking changes to the function/tool schema we should warn customers about?

sara: Only change is renaming `tool_input` -> `tool_args` and stricter JSON schema for tool outputs. Non-conforming outputs will fall back to text mode; opt-in strict validation available via `validation=strict` query param.

ana: Will we surface rollout status in the Console (customer-facing) or only internal?

sara: We'll show a customer-facing banner for GA and a per-tenant rollout toggle for early access. Internal rollout dashboard: Console → Deployments → Harbor-3.

ops-eng: No error spikes so far. CPU/GPU utilization within expected ranges.

support-sre: Escalation path added to on-call playbook; tag: #harbor-3-ga.

sara: Thanks everyone. If you see anything odd ping me directly or open a ticket with priority=high. Sync at 13:00 PTO to go over post-GA metrics. :rocket:
